name: Pointe Coupee Power Station gas supply pipeline
monitor_reason: No source names this pipeline. Both filings load and name Pointe Coupee, but neither describes a pipeline for those units, so there is no named project and no concrete step. The sponsor is only the plant owner, with no builder named.
researcher_notes: No existing row serves Pointe Coupee Parish. I read both Louisiana Public Service Commission documents in the Meta docket U-37882 in full text. One is a long intervenor testimony and the other is Entergy Louisiana testimony. They place three new gas units (Pointe Coupee Units 1, 2 and 3) near the Big Cajun site in Pointe Coupee Parish. The Entergy testimony says only that there will be costs for pipelines delivering gas to the proposed generators, and that its witness discusses pipeline arrangements in separate testimony. That covers all seven proposed units, including the four in Richland Parish. I did not find the claim that a new pipeline is needed for the Pointe Coupee units, nor any question about Natural Gas Act approval. One web search for a dedicated pipeline to the Big Cajun site found nothing. The data center tie to the plants (Meta) is real, but the pipeline itself is not named, so DataCenter stays blank. Revisit if the gas supply testimony, a Federal Energy Regulatory Commission filing, a state permit or a named builder appears. Confidence is low.
